Ginger Thins

Served at: Lussinatta (St. Lucia's Vigil)

Makes about 40 cookiesPrep 15 minCook 10 min

Ginger Thins are delicate, crispy cookies flavored with warm spices and ginger, traditionally served during Lussinatta, the vigil of St. Lucia's Day celebrated in Sweden and other Nordic countries. These cookies are enjoyed alongside coffee and saffron buns, adding a spicy sweetness to the festive gathering.

Ingredients

  • 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar
  • 1/2 cup (113 g) unsalted butter, softened
  • 1/4 cup (60 ml) molasses
  • 1 large egg
  • 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour
  • 1 teaspoon baking soda
  • 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon
  • 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger
  • 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves
  • 1/4 teaspoon salt

Method

  1. Preheat the oven to 350°F (175°C).
  2. In a large bowl, cream together the sugar and softened butter until light and fluffy.
  3. Beat in the molasses and egg until well combined.
  4. In a separate bowl, whisk together the flour, baking soda, cinnamon, ginger, cloves, and salt.
  5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients, mixing until a smooth dough forms.
  6. Drop teaspoonfuls of dough onto ungreased baking sheets, spacing them about 2 inches (5 cm) apart.
  7. Flatten each dough ball slightly with the back of a spoon or your fingers to form thin rounds.
  8. Bake for 8-10 minutes, or until the edges are firm and the cookies are golden brown.
  9. Remove from oven and allow cookies to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely.

Tips

  • For a stronger ginger flavor, add an extra 1/4 teaspoon of ground ginger.
  • Store cookies in an airtight container to maintain crispness.
  • These cookies pair wonderfully with a cup of strong coffee or mulled wine during the Lussinatta celebration.
